mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for a coordinated interior painting project with Frasheski Construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our coordinated interior painting process begins with an initial consultation to discuss your vision, colors, and project scope. We then provide a detailed estimate and schedule the work to align with your renovation timeline. Before painting, our team prepares all surfaces and protects your belongings. During painting, we ensure minimal disruption and maintain a clean worksite. Finally, we conduct a thorough inspection with you to ensure satisfaction and perform a comprehensive cleanup. This integrated approach ensures efficiency and high-quality results for your Berkeley or East Bay project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process involves consultation, detailed estimation, scheduling, surface preparation, painting with minimal disruption, final inspection, and cleanup for high-quality results.
